title: slo-toolkit: improved auto-diagnostics ranking + runbook linking and on-call helpers
author: Maya Ortiz
description: Motivation: On-call workflows during SLO incidents require faster context and higher-signal runbook suggestions. This PR enhances the SLO Toolkit's auto-diagnostics ranking and runbook linking heuristics, adds new on-call helper commands, and improves telemetry to make suggestions both more accurate and explainable. Summary of changes: 1) New ranking heuristics in slo_toolkit: feature-weighted scoring that combines recent error fingerprint frequency, metadata overlap, and past-runbook-success rates. 2) Runbook linking: enhanced fuzzy match + contextual scoring with a fallback to manual tags. Links are surfaced with confidence scores and explanation snippets. 3) On-call helpers: /incident summarize and /incident explain-runbook commands that produce compact runbook pointers and short rationales suitable for Slack and the web UI. 4) Diagnostics payload: structured diagnostic summary (short, medium, long) for downstream consumption by incident-bot and the SLO dashboard. 5) Telemetry: new metrics slo_toolkit.runbook_confidence, slo_toolkit.rank_latency_ms, incident_bot.helper_command_usage; added events for feedback signals (runbook_accepted/runbook_rejected). 6) Feature flagging: gated behind ff.slo_toolkit.autodiag_v2 with rollout at 25% by default. 7) Tests: unit tests for ranking logic, integration tests for end-to-end Slack command flows, e2e for runbook linking. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in ENG-4312 - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added (flaky case retried) - [x] Telemetry and dashboards updated - [x] Feature flag added - [x] Docs updated (internal runbooks.md) Notes: This is backwards compatible with the existing runbook API; existing consumers will see an extra confidence field but logic is tolerant of missing values. No breaking changes expected.
commits: Initial impl: add weighted ranking model and scoring pipeline (slo_toolkit/ranker.py)
Runbook linking: fuzzy matcher + context extractor (slo_toolkit/runbook_linker.py)
On-call helpers: add slash commands and handlers (/incident summarize, /incident explain-runbook)
Telemetry: emit runbook_confidence and rank_latency_ms metrics; add event hooks for accept/reject
Tests: unit and integration tests, add retry wrapper for flaky e2e test
Docs: update internal_docs/runbooks.md and rollout notes
review_comments: Arjun Patel (review): Can you add a short rationale for the selected weighting defaults? Also please ensure the ranker is O(n) in number of candidate runbooks — current approach looks like it could be quadratic in worst-case.
Maya Ortiz (author): Added comment block explaining default weights and switched the candidate scoring to a single-pass aggregator to avoid quadratic behavior. See ranker.py commit. PTAL.
Lina Gomez (review): Integration test failed on first CI run due to a flaky Slack test. Please add a retry and a short timeout to avoid CI noise.
Maya Ortiz (author): Added retry wrapper and increased mock timeout; re-ran CI. The integration test now consistently passes.
Priya Raman (approval): Verified telemetry events and dashboards. Approved pending a small docs tweak to surface the confidence field in the internal runbook doc.
Maya Ortiz (author): Addressed docs tweak (internal_docs/runbooks.md) and included sample output for /incident explain-runbook. Merging after green CI.
CI Bot: All checks green. Merging with squash.
Release Manager (note): Feature flag ff.slo_toolkit.autodiag_v2 will be rolled out to 25% and monitored for 48 hours before increasing to 100% as per ENG-4312 rollout plan.
release_notes: Enhances SLO Toolkit auto-diagnostics: improved runbook ranking, runbook confidence scores, new on-call helper commands, and additional telemetry. Feature-gated rollout. No breaking changes.
notes_for_ops: Enable ff.slo_toolkit.autodiag_v2 in staging and canary before production. Watch metrics slo_toolkit.runbook_confidence and slo_toolkit.rank_latency_ms; rollback if runbook acceptance drops >10% within 1 hour.
changelog_summary: Added v2 auto-diagnostics ranking and runbook linking. New on-call slash commands and metrics. Docs updated.
